cards.text: One day Jesus is driving out a demon that was mute. The demon leaves, and the man who couldn't say a word starts talking. Friend, I went quiet for YEARS in a junk drawer, and now look at me: I can't STOP.

cards.question: The man who couldn't talk is talking now. How do the crowds react?

cards.text: But hold on, not everybody's clapping. Some of them have a whole theory about HOW Jesus did it, and friend, it is NOT a compliment.

cards.question: Some in the crowd say it is by ___, the prince of the demons, that Jesus drives out demons.
Others in the crowd test Jesus a different way. What do they demand from Him?

cards.text: Jesus knows their thoughts, and friend, I can't even tell what my OVEN is thinking. He says every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste, and a house divided against a house will fall.

cards.question: Jesus says that if Satan is divided against himself, his kingdom will stand strong.

cards.text: Then Jesus takes their own claim and hands it RIGHT back to them, still warm, like a cookie fresh off the tray. If He drives out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do their own sons drive them out?

cards.question: Jesus asks the accusers by whom their own sons drive out demons. What does He say those sons will be to them?

cards.text: Now Jesus turns it all the way around: what if He drives out demons by the finger of God? One FINGER, friend, and I need my whole mustache just to lift a cookie box.

cards.question: If Jesus drives out demons by the finger of God, then the ___ of God has come upon them.

cards.text: Then Jesus paints a picture: when a strong man, fully armed, guards his house, his possessions are secure. FULLY armed, friend, and the only armor I've ever had is an apron.

cards.question: A strong man guards his house fully armed. Then someone stronger comes. What does Jesus say happens?

answers.text: He overpowers him and takes away his armor
He is driven off by the strong man's armor
He makes peace and leaves the house alone

cards.text: Then Jesus says, “He who is not with Me is against Me,” so there's no sitting on the fence. Friend, I tried sitting on a fence once, and with this gold base I just tipped RIGHT over.

cards.question: Jesus also says whoever does not gather with Him scatters.

cards.text: Then Jesus tells what happens when an unclean spirit comes out of a man. It passes through arid places seeking rest and doesn't find it, like me trying to nap while the oven timer goes off every four minutes.

cards.question: With no rest to be found, the unclean spirit says it will return to the ___ it left.

cards.text: On its return, it finds the house swept clean and put in order. Swept AND organized, friend, which is more than anybody ever did for that junk drawer I lived in.

cards.question: The unclean spirit finds the house swept clean and put in order. What does it do next?

answers.text: Brings seven spirits more wicked than itself
Brings two spirits weaker than itself
Leaves the house and never comes back

cards.question: By the end, the man the unclean spirit left and came back to is better off than he was at first.

cards.text: As Jesus is still answering the people who said He drives out demons by Beelzebul, a woman in the crowd raises her voice: “Blessed is the womb that bore You, and blessed are the breasts that nursed You!” Right in the MIDDLE of His teaching, friend, and I spent YEARS in a junk drawer too shy to ask a rubber band to scoot over.

cards.question: A woman calls a blessing on the mother who bore and nursed Jesus. Who does Jesus say are blessed rather?

answers.text: Those who hear the word of God and obey it
Those who pray and fast in the temple daily
Those who give to the poor and tell no one

cards.text: The crowds keep growing, and Jesus calls this a wicked generation that demands a sign. A man who couldn't talk is TALKING, and they still want proof, friend, that's like smelling my ovens and asking if I've EVER baked.

cards.question: Jesus says no sign will be given this generation except the sign of ___.
Jesus says that as the prophet Jonah was a sign to the Ninevites, the Son of Man will be a sign to this generation.

cards.text: Then Jesus brings up the Queen of the South, the queen of Sheba, who came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, king of Israel (1 Kings 10:1). The ENDS of the earth, friend, and I won't even walk across my bakery when the timer goes off.

cards.question: The Queen of the South came to hear Solomon's wisdom, and Jesus says now One ___ than Solomon is here.
Jesus says the Queen of the South will rise at the judgment and defend the men of this generation.

cards.text: Then Jesus says the men of Nineveh will stand at the judgment with this generation and condemn it too. First a queen, now a whole CITY, friend, that is a ROUGH guest list.

cards.question: Why will the men of Nineveh condemn this generation at the judgment?

answers.text: They repented at the preaching of Jonah
They tore down the idols in their city
They built an altar to the God of Israel

cards.text: And just like with Solomon, Jesus says now One greater than Jonah is here. Friend, Jonah spent three days inside a fish (Jonah 1:17), and I still think my years in a junk drawer make a good story.
Then Jesus switches pictures. No one lights a lamp and puts it in a cellar or under a basket, and that's like baking a perfect batch and hiding the box in the junk drawer.

cards.question: No one hides a lit lamp in a cellar. He sets it on a stand instead. Why?

answers.text: So those who enter can see the light
So the flame stays safe from the wind
So the oil lasts through the night

cards.text: Then Jesus brings the lamp picture closer to home: your eye is the lamp of your body. Friend, with these eyebrows hanging over mine, my lamp comes with a LAMPSHADE.

cards.question: Jesus says that when your eyes are good, your whole body is full of darkness.
Jesus says the eye is the lamp of the body. What does He tell them to be careful about?

answers.text: That the light within them is not darkness
That their lamps never run out of oil
That no one walks off with their lamp

cards.text: Jesus finishes the lamp picture with a whole body full of light, with no part of it in darkness. No dark corners at ALL, friend, and I spent years living in NOTHING but a dark corner.

cards.question: If your whole body is full of light with no part of it in darkness, what does Jesus say you will be?

answers.text: Radiant as though a lamp were shining on you
Wise as though you had heard Solomon speak
Warm as though you sat beside a fire
